verdict.rationale: Brevo is a SaaS marketing platform with AI features such as Aura AI, live-chat summarization and an MCP integration, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any control or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The MCP and AI-feature items describe AI capabilities, not data-use controls, and the community items are about account compromise, not training data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
